target_pattern: Use soler plus infinitive to express present routines and past used-to habits with minimal conjugation load.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Overbuilding habitual meaning with adverbs and fully conjugated second verbs.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish compresses routine meaning through soler plus infinitive, with present forms for usually and imperfect forms for used to.
target_pattern_formula: present routine: suelo sueles suele solemos suelen plus infinitive
past routine: solia solias solia soliamos solian plus infinitive
main action stays infinitive after soler
subject pronoun often omitted in present
subject may be included in imperfect when context is ambiguous
natural_examples: Mi hermano suele levantarse a las seis.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Suelo fumar. -> change infinitive to correr.
Base: Mi hermano suele levantarse temprano. -> change subject to plural mis hermanos.
Base: Solemos cocinar en casa. -> change infinitive to comer.
Base: Solia leer todas las noches. -> change infinitive to escribir.
Base: Juan solia tocar la guitarra. -> change instrument to el piano.
Base: Mis padres solian viajar mucho. -> change adverb to poco.
Base: Sueles tomar cafe por la manana. -> change drink to te.
Base: Ella suele estudiar antes de dormir. -> change infinitive to meditar.
Base: Soliamos ver esa serie juntos. -> change noun to esa pelicula.
Base: El suele olvidar sus llaves. -> change object to su cartera.
Base: Yo solia cocinar con mi abuela. -> change person to nosotros.
Base: Ustedes suelen terminar tarde. -> change adverb to temprano.
Base: Mis amigos solian venir los domingos. -> change day to los viernes.
Base: Suelo escuchar podcasts mientras conduzco. -> change infinitive to leer noticias.
Base: Mi jefe solia llegar muy temprano. -> change tense to present habitual.

prompts: I usually read at night. (Suelo leer por la noche. vs Estoy leyendo por la noche.)
We used to travel a lot. (Soliamos viajar mucho. vs Viajabamos mucho ahora.)
She usually studies before bed. (Suele estudiar antes de dormir. vs Suele estudia antes de dormir.)
They used to arrive late. (Solian llegar tarde. vs Suelen llegar tarde ayer.)
You usually exercise in the morning. (Sueles hacer ejercicio por la manana. vs Soles hacer ejercicio por la manana.)
My father used to cook on Sundays. (Mi padre solia cocinar los domingos. vs Mi padre suele cocinar los domingos antes.)
We usually eat outside on Fridays. (Solemos comer fuera los viernes. vs Comemos solemos fuera los viernes.)
I used to listen to that band a lot. (Yo solia escuchar mucho esa banda. vs Yo suelo escuchar mucho esa banda cuando era nino.)
They usually call at night. (Suelen llamar por la noche. vs Solen llamar por la noche.)
You all used to work together. (Ustedes solian trabajar juntos. vs Ustedes suelen trabajar juntos antes.)

common_errors.correct_spanish: Conjugate soler and keep second verb infinitive.

common_errors.mistake: Present soler used for past routine meaning
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use imperfect soler forms for used-to meaning.

common_errors.mistake: Soler avoided in favor of only adverbs
common_errors.why_it_happens: Learner relies on normalmente and usually equivalents.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use soler as a core habitual frame.

common_errors.mistake: Non-standard forms like soles or solen
common_errors.correct_spanish: Memorize present and imperfect forms accurately.

common_errors.mistake: Subject pronoun forced in every sentence
common_errors.correct_spanish: Drop subject when context is clear.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Sole form overlap not resolved by context.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Add explicit subject when needed for clarity.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Habitual and punctual events are mixed.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use soler for repeated actions only.

common_errors.mistake: Progressive forms mixed with habitual meaning
common_errors.why_it_happens: Current action and routine action confused.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use soler for routine, progressive for ongoing action.

common_errors.mistake: Soler avoided due to irregularity fear
common_errors.why_it_happens: Low confidence with stem changes and accent marks.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Automate chunk templates with daily repetition.
